organizationId.description: The risk scope, null for the whole tenant, which declares nothing.

kind.description: The kind of asset the answer counts.

low.description: The fewest assets of the kind the scope holds.

high.description: The most assets of the kind the scope holds. An exact number is two equal bounds.

bounds.description: A number of assets, as a low and a high bound; null clears the answer, its exposure included.

internetFacing.description: Whether at least one asset of the kind is reachable from the Internet; null when unanswered. Only asked of the kinds that can be exposed, and of an answer above zero.

answers.description: The kinds to change. A kind left out keeps its answer; a kind sent with null bounds loses it. Counts are numbers of assets, and an exact number is two equal bounds.
